    History

    Guide

    🔁

    The triple-feed cycle

    Each session has three parts: nurse at the breast, offer a bottle top-up, then pump. Log all three on one row. A row with only pumping is marked ⚡ and isn’t counted as a feed. Only nursing, or only bottles? In Settings, under What you track, turn off what you don’t use and Cradle hides it everywhere.

    🤱

    Breast tracking

    If you nurse on both sides, tap both. The first side you tap gets the dot, so you know where to start next time. To time a feed, tap ▶ next to Minutes when you start and ■ when you finish. The minutes fill in for you, or you can type them. With both sides on, a Left ↔ Right slider appears: slide it toward the side that got more time, and it splits the minutes (for example, 20 minutes slid to 75% left is 15 left and 5 right). Leave it in the middle for an even split.

    💧

    Diaper checks

    If a diaper has both urine and stool, mark both on that feed. For a change between feeds, tap 🧷 Diaper only; those rows don't count as feeds. Goals follow the baby's age: 1 of each on the birth day (Day 0), then 1 on day 1, up to 5 on day 5, then at least 4 of each per day.

    🛁

    Baths

    Tap 🛁 Bath under Since last feed to log a bath with the current time. Choose Sponge or Tub and add a note if you like, such as a hair wash or nail trim. Cradle remembers which kind you used last. Baths don’t count as feeds, so they never change feed totals or when the next feed is due. The Log shows today’s bath or when the last one was, and the Dashboard, History, print sheet, and doctor report all include baths.

    ☀️

    Vitamin D

    Tap ☀️ on the feed where you gave the drops. Giving them at the same feed each day, like the first morning feed, makes it easier to remember. You'll get a heads-up if it's already logged that day.

    ⏱️

    Pump timer

    Start the timer when you start pumping. The green arc shows your target window.

    😴

    Sleep

    Optional: turn on 😴 Sleep in Settings, under What you track. Then tap 😴 Asleep under Since last feed when the baby falls asleep, and ☀️ Woke up when they wake (also in Night shift). Everyone in the family sees a sleep in progress. The line under Since last feed shows how long the baby has been asleep, or awake since the last sleep. Type or change the start and wake times on the row. Sleeps from 7pm to 7am count as night sleep, others as naps, and a sleep across midnight is split between the days. Set a daily goal in Settings (15 hours to start); the Dashboard charts night sleep and naps. Sleep never counts as a feed.

    📄

    Terms and privacy

    If whoever runs this Cradle has turned it on, you’re asked to read and accept its terms and privacy notice after signing in. The database records which version you accepted and when, and your log syncs once you have. When the terms change, you’re asked again. Read them any time from About, which also shows when you accepted them.

    🦉

    Owlet Dream Sock

    Turning on Sleep in Settings asks whether you have an Owlet Dream Sock. Say yes, or tick 🦉 Dream Sock beside Sleep any time later, and the form appears. Your family must require two-step sign-in first (the family owner turns it on in Family), because Cradle keeps your Owlet sign-in. Then enter your Owlet email and password once and tap Connect; one person connects it for the whole family. About once a minute Cradle checks the sock: after 3 minutes asleep it starts a sleep row marked from Owlet, and after 5 minutes awake (or with the sock off or charging) it fills in the wake time. If you already tapped 😴 Asleep, it uses your row, and where sleeps overlap the totals count the time once. Your password isn’t saved, and heart rate and oxygen aren’t read into Cradle. It needs a one-time setup by whoever runs this Cradle, and since Owlet has no official connection, it can stop working if Owlet changes its app. Keep using Owlet’s app for alerts.

    🤸

    Tummy time

    Tap 🤸 Tummy time under Since last feed when the baby goes on their tummy. It adds a row with the time and starts its timer; tap ■ when it’s over and the minutes are saved (to the nearest minute). You can also type the minutes, or tap ▶ to time another stretch on the same row. On an earlier day, enter the time and minutes yourself. Tummy time never counts as a feed. The Tummy time tile shows today’s minutes against your daily goal, and turns green when you reach it. Set the goal in Settings (15 minutes to start; 0 turns the goal off), or turn tummy time off completely under What you track. Start with a few minutes a few times a day and build up, and ask your pediatrician what fits your baby. The Dashboard shows minutes per day, how often you met the goal, and a daily chart.

    📊

    Dashboard

    Shows the last 7 or 14 days ending on the day you have selected, including how many baths and when the last one was, and tummy time against your goal. Tap a chip under Print (Feeds, Bottle & pump, Diapers, Vitamin D, Tummy time, Weight, Baths) to see just that topic, or All for everything. Print prints what’s showing. Tap any chart to enlarge it, then tap a day or feed for details. The side balance also shows nursing time on each side, from the minutes and the split slider. Today counts as in progress until midnight.

    💬

    Send updates by text

    Each phone keeps its own copy of the log. To catch the other person up:

    1. On your phone: tap the profile button, then Data management, then Export data.
    2. Pick Last 2 days for a quick shift handoff, or Everything for a full copy.
    3. Tap 💬 Text message. Your messages app opens with the update ready. Send it.
    4. On their phone: long-press the message and tap Copy.
    5. Open Cradle, tap the profile button, then Data management, then Import data. Paste into the box and tap Continue.
    6. Tap Merge. New entries are added and matching times are updated. Nothing already logged is removed.

    If the text button doesn’t open your messages app, use 📋 Copy code and paste it into any message instead. Paste the whole message, including the line that starts with CRADLE.

    ☁︎

    Sign-in and sharing

    Sign in with your Cradle username (or email) and password. Everyone in your family shares one log: feeds, diapers, baths, notes, weights, and goals sync automatically, usually within about 15 seconds. Each phone also keeps its own copy, so Cradle works offline and catches up when it reconnects. The cloud icon in the header shows the sync status. In the profile menu, Sign out keeps the log on this phone for next time, and Sign out and remove from this phone (under Data management) clears the log, settings, and game scores from the phone too (it syncs first, and warns you if anything hasn’t reached your account yet). Either way, your log stays saved in your account.

    👪

    Family

    Everyone has their own login and a family shares one log. New here? On the sign-in screen tap Create an account, pick a username (or use your email) and a password. To share someone’s log, enter their share key (like K7QM-4XPD); leave it blank to start your own. Your share key is under Family in the profile menu, with a Share button that writes the invite text for you. The family owner can make a New key at any time, which stops the old one working, and can remove people. Members can leave. Other families never see your log. Everything saves as you type, with no Save button. If two of you edit the same feed, changes to different boxes are combined; if you both change the same box, the last one wins. When someone else’s change arrives, a note says who made it and the row flashes.

    🔐

    Two-step sign-in

    Adds a second step to signing in: after your password, Cradle asks for the 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, or Passwords on iPhone). Someone who learns your password still can’t open the log. Turn it on under Profile, then Sign-in and security: tap Add to authenticator app (or scan the code from another phone, or type the setup key), then enter the code it shows. Each phone asks for a code once, when you sign in. The family owner can tick Require it for everyone under Family (after turning it on for themselves); everyone else is then asked to set it up the next time they open Cradle, and the Family screen shows who has. There are no backup codes: if you lose the phone with your authenticator app, ask whoever runs your Cradle to reset it.

    💾

    Backups and files

    Your log is saved in your account and on each signed-in phone. Data management in the profile menu holds your data tools. Export data saves a backup file you can keep, or sends a short code by text message. Import data brings a file or code back: Merge adds to your log, Replace clears it first. Erase all data removes every entry from your family’s log on every phone, so only the family owner can use it; export first if you want a copy. Everyone can still delete single entries with ×. If a phone already has a log when you reach the sign-in screen, Cradle offers to download a backup before you sign in.

    🖨️

    Printing

    Every tab has a Print button. The Log tab prints a paper sheet for the selected day. Printing needs Cradle open in a browser like Chrome or Safari, not in a file preview.

    ⏰

    Next feed and alarm

    The Log tab shows when the next feed is due, based on the last feed and the interval in Settings (3 hours to start). When it's due, Cradle chimes, vibrates, and shows Snooze and Dismiss. This only works while Cradle is open on screen, so tap the screen once after opening it to allow sound. On a phone, ⏰ Set alarm shows the time to set in your Clock app, with the steps. Phones don’t let web apps add Clock alarms themselves, even when Cradle is installed, so that one takes a few taps. To be told when Cradle is closed, turn on 📣 Notify this phone in Settings: when a feed is due, or 15 or 30 minutes before. Each phone chooses for itself. On iPhone, add Cradle to the Home Screen first.

    🧊

    Milk storage

    Milk storage in the profile menu keeps track of pumped milk in the fridge and freezer. Add it as it goes in: when it was pumped, how much (type the number and tap mL or oz), the container, and how many if you filled several the same. Each section lists the oldest first, and the oldest frozen milk is marked Use first. Following CDC guidelines, Cradle flags fresh milk after 4 days in the fridge, frozen milk past 6 months (fine up to 12), and thawed milk after 24 hours. Freeze moves fridge milk to the freezer; Thaw moves frozen milk to the fridge and starts the 24 hours (thawed milk shouldn’t be refrozen). Tapped it by mistake? Undo on the message, or Undo thaw on the row, puts it back. Use can log a bottle feed with that amount, mark it used, or throw it away; it shows under Recently used, with Undo. Labels are optional: type the one on your bag, tap 📷 to scan a barcode with the camera, or tap Print labels for Cradle’s own barcode labels: pictures for a 40 × 14 mm label printer like the NIIMBOT P21 (print them from its app at 100%, with no scaling), or a sheet for a regular printer. A label written like 10/10/2026 - 8 A fills in the date and time pumped. Find by label at the top finds a container: type or scan the label (for Cradle’s, just the 5 letters after CM- will do), and a Bluetooth barcode scanner works there too. The menu shows how much you have stored. Everyone in the family sees the same stash.

    ⚖️

    Weighted feeds and weight

    For a weighted feed, tap ⚖️ on the feed and enter the weight before and after, in grams or in pounds and ounces. Tap g or lb oz to switch; it also changes how weights are shown everywhere. Cradle shows about how much was transferred (1 gram is about 1 mL). Log weights from visits with + Add weight on the Dashboard or Weights in the profile menu. Type weights like 7 lb 3.5 oz or 3270 g. Every weight is listed at the top of the Weights screen (See all on the Dashboard): tap Edit to fix one, or × to delete it. Weights from weighted feeds have Open feed, and the birth weight has Settings, where you change them.

    🩺

    Doctor report

    On the Dashboard, 🩺 Doctor report prints one page for appointments: weight against birth weight, daily feeds, nursing minutes with the left and right split, bottle and pump volumes, diapers against goals, Vitamin D, baths, weighted feeds, your day notes, and lines for questions. It covers the 7 or 14 days shown on the Dashboard.

    🌙

    Night shift

    Tap the Night shift button at the top right (the bottle, next to the moon) for a dim, low-glare screen with huge buttons for one-handed night feeds. The three dots at the top switch colors: Warm, Moonlight, or Red. Start feed logs the time and starts the timer. Then tap L or R (with both on, a slider splits the time between sides), adjust the bottle by 5 mL, mark wet, stool, or Vitamin D, and tap Done. Everything saves as you go. Between feeds, 🧷 Diaper only and 🛁 Bath log those with the current time.

    🌌

    Calm screen

    A slow, soothing screensaver with the time, time since the last feed, and the next feed due. Open it with the moon button at the top right, between Night shift and your profile. Tap the screen to show controls: spa music, ocean, rain, or white noise, volume, and whether the clock sits in the center or the corner. The feed alarm still works here. When Cradle is installed as an app, the screen stays on while Calm or Night shift is open. Opened as a file, your phone may still turn the screen off on its own timer.

    💬

    Support

    Open the profile menu and tap 💬 Support (next to Guide and About). Choose Bug or problem, Idea or request, or Question, describe it, and add a screenshot if it helps (it’s shrunk before sending). Your Cradle version and phone type go with it so it can be acted on. It goes to whoever runs this Cradle. Under Your feedback you’ll see each one’s status (New, Reviewed, Planned, Used, or Won’t do) and any reply; a number on Support means there’s an update. Feedback that gets reviewed earns Quality Assurance, and five reviewed earns Compliance Officer. Up to 10 a day.

    🏆

    Achievements

    Fifty-eight badges in nine groups (Feeds, Nursing, Bottle and pump, Diapers, Vitamin D, Baths, Weight and milestones, Fun center, and Support), like Sunshine Streak for 7 days of Vitamin D, Night Owl for 10 feeds between midnight and 5am, and Perfect Day. Stars mark the higher tiers of a badge. Open them from the profile menu to see progress. Streaks aren’t broken by a day that isn’t over yet. Fun center badges count the games played on this phone by whoever is signed in.

    🎓

    Learning center

    In the profile menu. High-contrast cards are five bold black-and-white designs (Bullseye, Checkerboard, Zigzag, Spiral, and Smile) for calm, awake moments with your baby. Tap one to show it full screen, then swipe or tap the sides to change cards. Invert swaps black and white, and Auto changes cards every 10 seconds. Hold the phone about 8 to 12 inches (20 to 30 cm) away, and stop when your baby looks away or fusses. The screen stays on while a card is showing. Baby mirror shows your baby’s face, mirrored and full screen, from the front camera, with a star or rainbow frame and zoom. Prop the phone up at eye level for tummy time. Press and hold Hold to close to leave, so little hands can’t close it. Nothing is recorded or saved, and the camera turns off when you leave.

    🎮

    Fun center

    In the profile menu: Bottle Catch, a two-minute, one-thumb game. Drag anywhere to move the basket. Bottles are +10, golden bottles +50, and catching in a row builds up to ×4. Safety pins cost a heart (you have 3), and the pacifier slows everything for 5 seconds. It pauses by itself if you switch away or the feed alarm rings. Sound is off to start; Buzz and Sound are on the start screen. Your first posted score asks for 3 initials, which you can change on the board. High scores has three boards: Everyone (each person’s best across this Cradle), Our family, and My best. Only initials and scores are shown. Scores from rounds played offline post when you’re back online.

    Daily Word: a new word every day at midnight. Guess it in 6 tries. Green is the right letter in the right spot, yellow is in the word but in the wrong spot, and gray isn’t in the word. Pick 4, 5, or 6 letters with the ? button; everyone who picks the same length gets the same word. When you’re done, it shows what the word means. Hard mode makes you use the letters you’ve found, for 10 extra points. A word is worth 70 points in 1 guess, down to 20 in 6. Your guesses are saved, so you can stop mid-word. Share copies your colored squares, and Practice gives unlimited words with no points. Its high scores show total points with 🔥 streaks, and your family’s grids for today (colors only) once you’ve played.

    Stork Flight: tap anywhere to flap, and fly a stork carrying a bundle through the gaps between the clouds and the chimneys. Each gap is +10, stars are +5, and passing a house with a lit window is a delivery, +25. The stork waits for your first tap, the flight starts gentle and speeds up, and one bump ends it. It pauses by itself if you switch away or the feed alarm rings. Its high scores work like Bottle Catch’s. Laundry Day: clean clothes pop out of the washer; swipe each into its basket (onesies left, socks right, bibs down) and anything stained back up to the washer, before it drops. 60 seconds, 10 points each, and streaks multiply them. The buttons at the top of High scores switch between the games.

    👤

    Profile menu

    The round button at the top right shows your picture. Your picture, at the top of its menu, lets you upload a photo or pick a built-in one (silhouettes and animals), and choose who sees it: only you, your family, or everyone on this Cradle (also on the high-score boards). The menu also holds Themes (Auto, Light, or Dark, plus fun themes: Dalmatian, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas), Achievements, Learning center, Fun center, Weights, Settings, Data management (export, import, print, erase all data, and sign out and remove from this phone), this Guide, About, Family, Sign-in and security (change password and two-step sign-in), and Sign out. Settings is where you set the baby’s name, birth date, birth weight, Vitamin D start date, what you track (breast, bottle, pump), feed interval, alarm, notifications, and goals, like the bottle target per feed. The moon button next to it opens Calm.

    This tracker is for keeping records only. Volumes, goals, and supplements should follow your pediatrician or lactation consultant. If you're worried about feeding, diapers, or weight gain, call your baby's doctor.

    Goals

    The birth date is Day 0 (goal 1 of each). Days 1 to 5, the goal matches the day: 1 on day 1, up to 5 on day 5. After that, the goals below apply.

    Start with a few minutes a few times a day and build up. Ask your pediatrician what fits your baby. 0 turns the goal off.

    Newborns often sleep 14 to 17 hours a day in short stretches. Ask your pediatrician what fits your baby. 0 turns the goal off.

    About Cradle

    Cradle v
    A baby log that works offline and syncs between family phones through your own Supabase project. No external libraries.

    New to Cradle, or telling someone about it? See the product overview. Is something down? Check the status page.

    Not medical advice. Cradle is a notebook. Goals in the app are placeholders, so follow your pediatrician or care team, and call them if you’re worried about your baby.

    Built with AI. Cradle was built with help from Claude, an AI model by Anthropic. It has been tested but not independently reviewed, so keep backups with Export data (in Data management).

    ☕
    Enjoying Cradle?
    It’s free. If it helps your family, you can buy me a coffee.

    Changelog

    v1.46
    • Milk storage: 📷 Scan now works on every phone with a camera, iPhones included. Where the browser has no barcode reader, Cradle reads the label’s barcode itself
    • Type just the 5 letters of a Cradle label (like 7KQ2M, in any case) to find it
    • Cleaner labels for 40 × 14 mm label printers: wider bars on whole printer dots, drawn a little thinner so they don’t run together, with more room each side. Reprint any that are hard to read; old labels still scan
    v1.45
    • Tummy time can be turned off in Settings, under What you track, like Breast, Bottle, Pump, and Sleep. Cradle then hides it everywhere; nothing logged is deleted
    v1.44
    • Baby mirror: the Rainbow frame is just a border now. It had covered the whole screen, hiding the camera
    v1.43
    • Baby mirror in the Learning center: your baby’s face, full screen from the front camera, with a star or rainbow frame and zoom. Press and hold to close, so little hands can’t. Nothing is recorded or saved
    v1.42
    • Laundry Day in the Fun center: swipe baby clothes into the right basket (onesies left, socks right, bibs down) and anything stained back up to the washer, for 60 seconds. Streaks multiply your points
    • High scores for everyone, your family, and you, and three new badges: Fresh Folds, Laundry Legend, and Perfect Pairs
    v1.41
    • Milk storage: tapped Thaw by mistake? Undo on the message puts it straight back in the freezer, and thawed milk has an Undo thaw button. Freeze has Undo too
    v1.40
    • Pumping isn’t a feed: a row with only a pump amount is marked ⚡, isn’t counted in Feeds, and doesn’t reset Since last feed. Its milk still counts in Pumped. Add a bottle or a side to make it a feed
    • Row numbers update as you type, when a row becomes a feed
    v1.39
    • Daily Word: after each game, win or lose, see what the word means, with a link to look it up in a dictionary. Works offline
    v1.38
    • Daily Word: ⌫ is now on the left of the bottom row and Enter on the right
    v1.37
    • Terms and privacy: when whoever runs this Cradle turns it on, you read and accept them after signing in, and the date you accepted is recorded. About shows the terms and when you accepted them
    • About now shows the right version number (it had stayed at v1.30)
    v1.36
    • Connecting an Owlet Dream Sock now requires two-step sign-in for the whole family (the owner turns it on in Family). If it’s turned off later, the sock’s checks pause until it’s back on
    v1.35

    • The status page shows whether the Owlet checks are running
    v1.34
    • Turning on Sleep asks whether you have an Owlet Dream Sock, and its settings show right away, with no save and reopen
    • A 🦉 Dream Sock box beside Sleep in What you track: greyed out until ticked, so you can set it up later
    • Sleep totals merge overlapping sleeps (one tapped by hand and one from Owlet, say), so time is never counted twice
    v1.33
    • Owlet Dream Sock: connect it in Settings (with Sleep on) and sleep is logged automatically, marked “from Owlet”, for the whole family
    • The Log shows the sock’s status (asleep, awake, charging) next to the asleep or awake line
    • Your Owlet password is used once and never saved; heart rate and oxygen aren’t read into Cradle. Needs a one-time setup by whoever runs this Cradle
    v1.32

    • Naps and night sleep, a daily sleep goal, a Dashboard chart, and sleep in History, print, and the doctor report
    v1.31
    • 💬 Support in the profile menu: send a bug, an idea, or a question, with an optional screenshot. You’ll see its status and the reply there
    • Two new achievements: Quality Assurance (feedback that gets reviewed) and Compliance Officer (five reviewed)
    • Admins get a Feedback inbox to read, filter, reply, and mark each one Reviewed, Planned, Used, or Won’t do
    v1.30
    • Tummy time: tap 🤸 Tummy time on the Log to start a timer, then ■ when it’s over, or type the minutes. It doesn’t count as a feed.
    • A daily tummy time goal in Settings (15 minutes to start), with progress on the Log
    • On the Dashboard: a tummy time tile, a daily chart with the goal line, an insight, and a Tummy time filter. Also in History, the day sheet, and the doctor report.
    v1.29
    • The Weight chart shows a weighted feed’s after weight too: a dot above the before circle, joined by a dashed line. Tap it to see how much was taken.
    v1.28
    • A status page at your Cradle’s address plus /status/: whether the site and database are up, uptime over 90 days, what’s deployed, and recent deployments with their test results. About links to it.
    v1.27
    • Milk storage: the amount has an mL / oz switch, so the number keyboard is all you need
    • Labels for a 40 × 14 mm label printer (like the NIIMBOT P21): Cradle makes a picture of each label to print from the printer’s app
    • A label written like 10/10/2026 - 8 A fills in the date and time pumped, and containers pumped together can share a label
    v1.26
    • Milk storage in the profile menu: pumped milk in the fridge and freezer, with when it was pumped, how much, and the container. Oldest first, with CDC limits flagged.
    • Thaw, Freeze, and Use (which can log a bottle feed with that amount), plus Recently used with Undo
    • Optional labels: type one, scan a barcode (on phones whose browser can), or print Cradle’s own barcode labels
    v1.25
    • Two-step sign-in: after your password, Cradle asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a password alone can’t open the log. Turn it on under Profile, then Sign-in and security.
    • Change password moved there too, so the profile menu stays short.
    • The family owner can require it for everyone under Family. Anyone who hasn’t set it up is asked to the next time they open Cradle, and the Family screen shows who has.
    v1.24
    • The product overview, a one-page tour of Cradle, is now on the web at your Cradle’s address plus /overview/, ready to share. About links to it.
    v1.23
    • Weights in grams or in lb and oz, with separate number boxes, for weighted feeds, the Weights screen, and the birth weight. Tap g or lb oz to switch, and what you’ve typed converts.
    v1.22
    • Your picture: upload a photo or pick Dad, Mom, Person, Bear, Bunny, Fox, or Owl. It shows on your profile button and the Family screen.
    • Choose who sees it: only you, your family, or everyone on this Cradle (also next to your initials on the high-score boards)
    • Night shift is now the bottle button at the top right, next to the moon. The tabs are Log, Dashboard, and History.
    v1.21
    • The day’s totals on the Log are in pairs: Feeds and Vitamin D, Pumped and Bottle, Wet and Stool, then Bath
    v1.20
    • The bottle target is clearly per feed everywhere: Settings, the Log’s Bottle card, the chart line, the Dashboard, and the printed day sheet. It always worked per feed; the labels just didn’t say so.
    • The Bottle Catch badges are now Catch Pro and Catch Legend, so they aren’t confused with the bottle-feeding badges
    v1.19
    • Stork Flight in the Fun center: tap to flap a stork carrying a bundle through the clouds and chimneys over a sleeping town. Stars and deliveries (houses with a lit window) are worth extra.
    • High scores now switch between all three games
    • 3 new Fun center achievements (53 in all): Night Flyer, Sky Captain, and Special Delivery
    • Bottle Catch’s start screen has a Close button
    v1.18
    • Daily Word in the Fun center: a new word every day to guess in 6 tries. Each person picks 4, 5, or 6 letters, and everyone with the same length gets the same word.
    • Hard mode, points, streaks, stats, Share (colored squares only), and unlimited Practice
    • High scores switch between Bottle Catch and Daily Word. Daily Word shows total points, 🔥 streaks, and your family’s grids for today once you’ve played.
    • 10 new Fun center achievements (50 in all)
    • Daily Word’s word lists come from SCOWL, Copyright 2000-2016 Kevin Atkinson, used with permission (see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)
    v1.17
    • What you track in Settings: turn off Breast, Bottle, or Pump if your family doesn’t use them, and Cradle hides them everywhere, including the Log, Night shift, the pump timer, the Dashboard, insights, the day sheet, and the doctor report. Shared with your family. Nothing logged is deleted.
    v1.16
    • 📣 Notifications: a phone can be told when a feed is due, or 15 or 30 minutes before, even when Cradle is closed. Turn it on in Settings, on each phone that wants it.
    • Needs a one-time setup in Supabase by whoever runs your Cradle
    • On iPhone, add Cradle to the Home Screen first
    v1.15
    • 40 achievements (up from 10), grouped by topic: higher tiers of the originals (★★ and ★★★) and new ones like Night Owl, Perfect Day, Liquid Gold, Splish Splash, Back to Birth Weight, and One Month Old
    • Themes now open from one 🎨 Themes item in the profile menu
    • Doctor report: pumping is averaged over the days you pumped, Vitamin D only counts days since its start date, days before birth are left out, and nursing shows how many feeds were timed
    • Dashboard: the same fixes for pumping and Vitamin D
    v1.14
    • Dashboard filters: chips under Print (All, Feeds, Bottle & pump, Diapers, Vitamin D, Weight, Baths) show just that topic’s cards and insights
    • Cradle remembers your filter, and Print prints what’s showing
    v1.13
    • 🦃 Thanksgiving mode: warm cream and maple colors, falling leaves and acorns, and an acorn cap on the logo
    • 🎄 Christmas mode: snowy white with red and evergreen, falling snowflakes, a candy-cane stripe under the header, and a Santa hat on the logo
    • Both are in Themes, next to Halloween, and like every theme they’re just for this phone
    • A shorter profile menu: Data management holds export, import, print, erase all data, and sign out and remove from this phone. Fun themes sit in a small grid.
    • ☕ An optional Buy me a coffee button, when your Cradle has a donation link set
    v1.12
    • New tagline: Family baby log on the splash and sign-in screens, and Baby log everywhere else, since Cradle works however your baby is fed
    • 🎃 Halloween mode in Appearance, under Dalmatian: a dark night theme with bats, pumpkin orange, and a jack-o’-lantern logo. It’s just for this phone.
    v1.11
    • Two people can edit the same feed at once: changes to different boxes are combined instead of one overwriting the other
    • While you’re typing, the rest of the Log still updates, and the box you’re in is left alone
    • A note says who changed what when someone else’s edit arrives, and the row flashes
    • Weights: review them at the top of the Weights screen, and tap Edit to fix one. See all on the Dashboard opens the list.
    v1.10
    • Left and right split: when you nurse on both sides, a slider divides the feed’s minutes between them (for example 15 left and 5 right)
    • The slider is on the Log and in Night shift
    • The Dashboard, chart explorer, printed day sheet, and doctor report show time on each side
    v1.9
    • Sign out and remove from this phone: clears the log, settings, and game scores from a shared or lost phone
    • Erase all data is now for the family owner only
    • Stronger web security: the site only runs Cradle’s own code and only talks to your database
    • The profile menu scrolls on small screens
    v1.8
    • Fun center in the profile menu with Bottle Catch, a two-minute one-thumb game
    • Arcade-style high scores with your initials: Everyone, Our family, and My best
    • The game pauses itself when you switch away or the feed alarm rings
    v1.7
    • Learning center in the profile menu, with five high-contrast black-and-white cards to show your baby
    • ⏰ Set alarm shows the time to set on your phone, big and clear, with the steps
    v1.6
    • Bath logging: 🛁 Bath on the Log and in Night shift, with Sponge or Tub and a note
    • Baths on the Log, Dashboard (tile and insight), History, chart details, print sheet, and doctor report
    • Baths never count as feeds
    v1.5
    • Family sharing: everyone has their own login, and a family shares one log
    • Create an account from the sign-in screen, with share keys to join a family
    • Family screen: share key, Share invite text, New key, add by email, remove people, leave
    • Welcome screen for new family members
    • Change password
    • Sign-in screen offers a backup when the phone already has a log
    • Tabs reordered: Log, Night shift, Dashboard, History
    • Calm is now the moon button at the top right
    • Phone alarm button shows the time to set (Android blocks web apps from setting Clock alarms)
    v1.4
    • Splash screen and sign-in
    • Shared log that syncs between phones
    • Works offline and catches up when back online
    • Installable app
    • Sign out from the profile menu

    • Next feed due time with an in-app alarm, snooze, and a phone alarm button on Android
    • Weighted feeds with before and after weights
    • Weight tracking with a chart against birth weight
    • Doctor report from the Dashboard
